selection: Each run uses its one selected candidate across all four datasets; not a separately chosen best per dataset.
tokens: LLM requests jointly cover four datasets. Tokens are accounted per search run; dataset-specific token usage is not recorded.
history: Historical posthoc single-model selections and different budgets/starting points retain explicit cohort/performance_mode labels.
validation: Validation results are written to a separate file; unfinished searches have no test values.
